operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Deletes a requisition (and its related stock movements) identified by its id.

This is a UI-oriented action and does **not** return a JSON body. To actually delete through the API you must pass `force=1` as a query parameter — without it the request returns the HTML delete-confirmation page and nothing is deleted.

On success the request is redirected (HTTP `302`) to the requisitions list. Pre-delete guards (closed accounting period, another branch, a pending order, a locked item, insufficient stock, tracking, or a linked manufacturing order) also surface as redirects with a flash message rather than a structured JSON error.

To delete a requisition and receive a machine-readable result, prefer the v2 entity API for the `requisition` entity.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The requisition id to delete (digits only).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Set to `1` to perform the deletion. Without it the endpoint returns the HTML confirmation page and does not delete.

200.description: When `force` is omitted, the HTML delete-confirmation page is returned and the requisition is not deleted.

302.description: The requisition was deleted (when `force=1`). The response is a redirect to the requisitions list with no body. Pre-delete validation failures also redirect, with the reason shown as a flash message.
